shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished desktop website design proposal for APSI BTP, French construction project coordination firm. Output a flat screenshot, landscape 1400x720 composition, no device frame, no surrounding board, no labels outside the website. The attached images 1-4 are APPROVED page screenshots: copy their exact established branding, APSI logo, header proportions (108px high), blue trapezoid behind white logo at left, white navigation with QUI SOMMES-NOUS, NOS MÉTIERS, NOS RÉFÉRENCES, NOS CLIENTS and blue Nous contacter CTA at right, Montserrat bold headings, Inter body, blue #0067d6, navy #061733, white backgrounds and restrained pale blue, angular diagonal construction photo with pale blue border, white cards rounded 10px and subtle shadows. Attached image 5 is the CURRENT page to redesign: retain its factual content and branding, improve layout to match approved references. Do not invent statistics, client names, addresses or legal claims. Crisp readable French, elegant spacious functional UI. Page can continue below fold. Keep key information comfortably legible at this viewport.
